news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹6.17 loss per share (vs ₹1.92 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹6.17 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹1.92 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹14.5m (down 9.2% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹3.86m (loss widened 221% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 82 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.0x net interest cover). news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.60 loss per share (vs ₹3.71 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.60 loss per share (improved from ₹3.71 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹18.8m (up 48% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹316.0k (loss narrowed 86% from 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 57% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 3% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
